verdict: No paid activity this period; Google Business presence is fading.
narrative: There was no paid advertising spend across Meta or Google in the last 28 days, which means no paid leads were generated this period. Your Google Business profiles remained the only active source of visibility, producing 170 total actions — but engagement dropped sharply over the last 7 days, down 80% compared to the prior 7-day stretch. Across all three profiles, 951 impressions resulted in just 3 calls, indicating the listings are reaching people but not compelling enough to prompt direct contact. Profile content and calls-to-action are being reviewed and strengthened this week to reverse the engagement decline.
